jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer – Finance
jobs.description: We're Scan.com . We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster. We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo. We're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer, Finance at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year. Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that. You'll sit within Finance, with a dotted-line relationship to our VP Data & AI, working where Finance, Data and Engineering meet. You'll have real autonomy to design and build scalable solutions, while staying aligned with our wider data architecture and engineering standards. Our core stack includes NetSuite, Fivetran, Snowflake and dbt , alongside internal operational platforms and external financial data sources. As a scale-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the things you could be getting involved in: Own the design and development of Finance's data architecture and models, creating a single, trusted source of truth for financial reporting and analysis. Build and maintain automated pipelines and transformations across NetSuite, Snowflake, dbt and our operational systems.

Process Improvement: Recommend process improvements to streamline tax compliance and documentation.
